The iam:PassRole statement is the one people either forget (deploys fail with
AccessDenied on RegisterTaskDefinition) or make far too broad. Registering a
task definition means handing ECS two roles, so the deployer needs PassRole for
exactly those two ARNs -- and the ViaService condition means it can only pass
them to ECS, not to some other service.
